key.name: colour-picker
key.summary: Pick a colour from the screen
key.description: A loupe over the screen; a click copies the colour under it as hex, with Shift as rgb() and with Ctrl as hsl(). An empty list turns the picker off.

key.name: mute-microphone
key.summary: Mute the microphone in every app
key.description: Mutes the default input, or turns it back on. While it is muted a mark stays in the top bar. An empty list leaves the key unbound.

key.name: convert-in-files
key.description: Files' Scripts menu gains Convert: a picture as PNG, JPEG or WebP, half the size or 1920 pixels wide, or several in one PDF, each written as a new file beside it.

key.name: earlier-versions
key.description: Files' Scripts menu has Earlier versions, which opens Backups on the versions the snapshots and the backup keep of a file.

key.name: open-anything
key.summary: A file nothing opens says what it is
key.description: Opening a kind of file nothing here opens says what it is and offers the app on Flathub that does. Off, GNOME says there is no app for it, as before.

key.name: uninstall-takes-data
key.summary: Uninstall takes the app's data to the trash
key.description: Uninstall says what an app leaves behind and moves it to the trash with the app's removal. Off, it asks whether to keep or delete the data, as before.

key.name: offer-room
key.summary: Offer to clear space when the disk runs low
key.description: When GNOME's low-space notice fires, it is replaced by one that says how much can be cleared and that none of it is the person's work. Off, GNOME's notice shows as before.

key.name: network-reach
key.description: The Wi-Fi and wired menus draw you, the router and the internet, with the line that broke. Each time the menu opens, one ping goes to the router and one name lookup to your name server. `ame desktop network-check on|off` and Control write it.
